80: - **Observability**: Every API response propagates `X-Correlation-ID` and every error response returns RFC 7807 `application/problem+json` with `correlationId`, `errorCode`, and `timestamp`.
81: - **Stack & Async/Cache Justification (`project-delivery-core.mdc`)**: Java 21 / Spring Boot 4.1.1 modular monolith (`app/backend/`). Async batch report transformation (`HTTP 202 Accepted` on `POST /api/v1/runs` polled via `GET /api/v1/runs/{id}`) is justified by `< 60 minute` batch transformation SLA for `< 50 MB` CSV inputs; Redis session/lock caching is justified by fail-closed token revocation and distributed worker lease coordination (`docs/agents-v0/architecture.md`).
82: 
83: ## Security-review triggers
84: 
85: - `auth` — `/api/v1/auth/login`, `/api/v1/auth/callback`, `/api/v1/auth/me`, `/api/v1/auth/logout`, and `/api/v1/auth/mock-login` OIDC and fail-closed Redis session contracts (`security-baseline.mdc` §2, VAPT F9).
86: - `upload` — `POST /api/v1/runs` (`multipart/form-data` CSV source upload), `POST /api/v1/reference-tables/{id}/import` (CSV reference import), and `POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/attachments` (evidence file upload) with size limits, MIME/extension allowlists, and SHA-256 checksum metadata (`security-baseline.mdc` §5).
87: - `RBAC` — `/api/v1/iam/roles/**`, `/api/v1/iam/permissions/**`, `/api/v1/iam/users/**`, `/api/v1/iam/role-applications/**`, `/api/v1/iam/sod-rules/**`, `/api/v1/iam/view-as/**`, and `/api/v1/iam/exports/**` role/permission management, Segregation of Duties (SoD) conflict detection, and read-only View-As impersonation contracts (`security-baseline.mdc` §2).
88: - `{id}` path — `/api/v1/runs/{id}`, `/api/v1/runs/{id}/artifacts/{type}`, `/api/v1/definitions/{id}`, `/api/v1/reference-tables/{id}`, `/api/v1/schedules/{id}`, `/api/v1/tickets/{id}`, `/api/v1/notifications/{id}`, `/api/v1/iam/users/{id}`, `/api/v1/iam/roles/{id}`, and `/api/v1/iam/permissions/{id}` re

ties (SoD) between `PREPARER`, `APPROVER`, and `ADMIN`, dual-control maker-checker endorsement/approval workflows, and 13-month online / 7-year archived immutable audit trail (`audit_log_entries`).
94: - **Philippines Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173) & GDPR**: Protects corporate workspace identity (`workspace_email`, `display_name`, IP address, user agent) with authenticated access controls, masked/sanitized error payloads, and zero PII leakage in RFC 7807 `ProblemDetail` responses.
95: - **Internal GXI Enterprise Governance & Security Baseline (`security-baseline.mdc`)**: Enforces fail-closed session validation, strict input validation (`additionalProperties: false`), `Idempotency-Key` protection on financial/governance state creation, and standardized correlation tracing.
